local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local char = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()

local humanoid = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local root = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

-- ANTI SLIP
humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown,false)
humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll,false)

-- MAIN ANIMATION
local anim = Instance.new("Animation")
anim.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://91409825184210"

local track = humanoid:LoadAnimation(anim)
track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4
track.Looped = true

-- DOUBLE JUMP ANIMATION
local jumpAnim = Instance.new("Animation")
jumpAnim.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://476778305"

local jumpTrack = humanoid:LoadAnimation(jumpAnim)
jumpTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4

local canDouble = false
local usedDouble = false

-- NO STUN
local function removeStun()

	for _,v in pairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
		
		local name = string.lower(v.Name)

		if name:find("stun")
		or name:find("freeze")
		or name:find("ragdoll") then
			
			pcall(function()
				v:Destroy()
			end)
		end
	end
end

-- KEEP ANIMATION PLAYING
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()

	removeStun()

	for _,v in pairs(humanoid:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
		
		if v ~= track and v ~= jumpTrack then
			v:Stop()
		end
	end

	if not track.IsPlaying then
		track:Play()
	end
end)

-- DETECT JUMP
humanoid.StateChanged:Connect(function(_,new)

	if new == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping then
		
		if not canDouble then
			canDouble = true
			usedDouble = false
		end
	end

	if new == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed then
		
		canDouble = false
		usedDouble = false
	end
end)

-- DOUBLE JUMP
UIS.JumpRequest:Connect(function()

	if canDouble and not usedDouble then
		
		usedDouble = true

		root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(
			root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.X,
			85,
			root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Z
		)

		jumpTrack:Play()

		task.delay(0.3,function()
			jumpTrack:Stop()
		end)
	end
end)
print("[May the bullying commence]")

    local function makeAntiSlip(part)
        if part:IsA("BasePart") then
            part.CustomPhysicalProperties = PhysicalProperties.new(1, 1.5, 0, 1.5, 0)
        end
    end

    for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        makeAntiSlip(obj)
    end

    workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
        makeAntiSlip(obj)
    end) 

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local function antiStun(char)
    local humanoid = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if CollectionService:HasTag(char, "Stunned") then
            CollectionService:RemoveTag(char, "Stunned")
        end
        
        local currentState = humanoid:GetState()
        if currentState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics or 
           currentState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll or 
           currentState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown or
           currentState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.PlatformStanding then
            humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.RunningNoPhysics)
        end
    end)
end

if lp.Character then
    antiStun(lp.Character)
end

lp.CharacterAdded:Connect(antiStun)

-- OVA METAL SONIC DARK LMS FORM

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()

local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local hrp = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

local transformed = false

-- RESPAWN
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c)

	character = c
	humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
	hrp = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	transformed = false
end)

-- PLAYER MODEL
local function getPlayerModel()

	local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("Players")

	if not folder then
		return nil
	end

	return folder:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
end

-- LMS DETECTOR
local function isLastLife()

	local model = getPlayerModel()

	return model and model:GetAttribute("LastLife") == true
end

-- CHAOS EMERALDS INTRO
local function playChaosEmeraldIntro(callback)

	local chaosEmeraldsId = 127338011222921

	local success, objects =
		pcall(game.GetObjects, game, "rbxassetid://" .. chaosEmeraldsId)

	if not success or #objects == 0 then

		if callback then
			callback()
		end

		return
	end

	local chaosModel = objects[1]:Clone()
	chaosModel.Parent = workspace

	local emeralds = {}

	for _,obj in ipairs(chaosModel:GetDescendants()) do

		if obj:IsA("MeshPart") then

			table.insert(emeralds,obj)

			obj.Anchored = false
			obj.CanCollide = false
		end
	end

	local radius = 7
	local angleStep = (2 * math.pi) / #emeralds

	local spin = 0

	local connection

	connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)

		spin += dt * 4

		for i,emerald in ipairs(emeralds) do

			local angle = (i * angleStep) + spin

			local x = math.cos(angle) * radius
			local z = math.sin(angle) * radius

			emerald.Position =
				hrp.Position + Vector3.new(x,2,z)
		end
	end)

	task.wait(2)

	connection:Disconnect()

	for _,emerald in ipairs(emeralds) do

		local tween = TweenService:Create(
			emerald,
			TweenInfo.new(0.25),
			{
				Position = hrp.Position
			}
		)

		tween:Play()
	end

	task.wait(0.35)

	chaosModel:Destroy()

	if callback then
		callback()
	end
end

-- DARK FORM
local function makeDarkForm()

	if transformed then
		return
	end

	transformed = true

	local blackColor = Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0)
	local whiteColor = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)

	for _,obj in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do

		if obj:IsA("BasePart") then

			local name = obj.Name:lower()

			-- EYES
			if string.find(name,"eye")
			or string.find(name,"pupil")
			or string.find(name,"iris") then

				obj.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
				obj.Color = whiteColor

			else

				-- TODO NEGRO
				obj.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
				obj.Color = blackColor
			end
		end
	end

	-- AURA
	local aura = Instance.new("Highlight")

	aura.FillColor = blackColor
	aura.FillTransparency = 0.4

	aura.OutlineColor = whiteColor
	aura.OutlineTransparency = 0

	aura.Parent = character

	-- Sound
	local sound = Instance.new("Sound")

	sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://9129996965"
	sound.Volume = 2

	sound.Parent = hrp

	sound:Play()

	-- SPEED
	humanoid.WalkSpeed += 4
end

-- LMS CHECK
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()

	if isLastLife() and not transformed then

		playChaosEmeraldIntro(function()

			makeDarkForm()
		end)
	end
end)

local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local humanoidRootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

-- ============================================================
-- SCRIPT 1: FLIGHT SYSTEM (3s) + SOFT BUTTON (40x40) + FOV 120
-- ============================================================

local FLY_SFX_ID = 118787708282878
local FLY_DURATION = 3 
local FLY_SPEED = 120
local NORMAL_FOV = 70
local MAX_FOV = 120
local isFlying = false

local sfx = Instance.new("Sound", humanoidRootPart)
sfx.SoundId = "rbxassetid://" .. FLY_SFX_ID
sfx.Volume = 1
sfx.Looped = true

local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui", playerGui)
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = true -- CAMBIADO A TRUE: El botón desaparece al morir/respawnear

local flyBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", screenGui)
flyBtn.Name = "SoftFlyButton"
flyBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 40, 0, 40)
flyBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.85, 0, 0.5, 0)
flyBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
flyBtn.Text = ""
flyBtn.Rotation = 45

local uiCorner = Instance.new("UICorner", flyBtn)
uiCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

local uiStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", flyBtn)
uiStroke.Color = Color3.new(0, 1, 1)
uiStroke.Thickness = 2
uiStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border

local function tweenFOV(target)
    local info = TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
    TweenService:Create(camera, info, {FieldOfView = target}):Play()
end

local bv, bg, renderConn

local function stopFlying()
    isFlying = false
    if bv then bv:Destroy() end
    if bg then bg:Destroy() end
    if renderConn then renderConn:Disconnect() end
    sfx:Stop()
    humanoid.PlatformStand = false
    flyBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
    tweenFOV(NORMAL_FOV)
end

local function startFlying()
    if isFlying then return end
    isFlying = true
    humanoid.PlatformStand = true
    flyBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 100)
    tweenFOV(MAX_FOV)
    
    bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity", humanoidRootPart)
    bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1) * math.huge
    bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro", humanoidRootPart)
    bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1) * math.huge
    sfx:Play()

    renderConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if isFlying and bv and bg then
            if humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then
                bv.Velocity = camera.CFrame.LookVector * FLY_SPEED
            else
                bv.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
            end
            bg.CFrame = camera.CFrame
        end
    end)

    task.delay(FLY_DURATION, function()
        stopFlying()
    end)
end

flyBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(startFlying)

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(newChar)
    character = newChar
    humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    humanoidRootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    stopFlying()
    sfx.Parent = humanoidRootPart
    camera.FieldOfView = NORMAL_FOV
end)
